affected_component: Workspace contract satisfiability, reference diagnostics, failure ownership and drafter evidence context
invariant: Before a workspace task can solicit representative fixtures or consume Agent budget, every required literal artifact must fit within the declared file, depth and path limits. A deterministic exception raised by the unfrozen task reference is CONTRACT-owned and must expose only a stable exception class, while isolation/start/process failures remain HARNESS-owned. When static scanning is truncated, bounded README and factual quickstart evidence must remain available to drafting so an incidental API probe cannot substitute for the user's primary requested capability.
